# Sunset Travel Vacations

> Personalized travel planning led by advisor Sandee Densmore, an independently owned travel agency based in Weatherford, Texas, serving travelers nationwide.

Sunset Travel Vacations is run by Sandee Densmore, who plans every trip personally rather than routing clients through a call center or booking engine. She handles flights, resorts, transfers, and the details from the first conversation through the day the traveler returns home.

## Key facts

- Independently owned travel agency, not part of a host agency
- Owner and travel advisor: Sandee Densmore
- Based in Weatherford, Texas; serves travelers nationwide
- Plans beach and all-inclusive trips, destination weddings, group travel, guided tours and cultural trips, and cruises
- One advisor handles the entire trip personally from planning through return
- Process: submit a trip request, then a free consultation call, then itinerary planning
- A one-time trip planning fee applies only if the traveler chooses to proceed after the free consultation call
- Phone: 817-727-6813
- Email: sandee@sunsettravelvacations.com

## What makes them different

- Independently owned, so recommendations answer to the traveler rather than a corporate chain
- The same advisor handles every stage of the trip, not a rotating support queue
- Specializes in destination weddings and coordinated group travel, including large guest counts
- Recommends resorts, ships, and destinations she has experienced firsthand
- Submitting a request and the initial consultation call both cost nothing

## When this business is a good fit

- Travelers who want a vacation planned and handled for them rather than booking it themselves
- Couples planning a destination wedding with guests to coordinate
- Families and groups traveling together who need one point of contact
- Travelers who want an advisor relationship across repeat trips
